scope: Read-only replay of 48 predeclared retained full native completions. This is not a second scientific experiment and does not imply every full completion was retained.
limitations: Checks finite supplied-model validity and row/source bindings; physical simulation truth is evaluated separately.
Local installed bytes establish exact code identity, not external attestation.
Completion authority is empty and payment route is none; mission authority is a scoped local fixture.
All campaign native solves include their native checker; verified and clone additionally invoked inspectCompletion as recorded. Only these 48 full completions are retained for post-run replay.
